definitions.explanation: Aromatic plant-derived substances used to flavor food, such as pepper, cinnamon, or ginger.

notes:
Common spices ({香辛料|こうしんりょう}):
- ⟦こしょう→胡椒：10321_koshou⟧/⟦ペッパー→ペッパー：28736_peppaa⟧ (pepper)
- ⟦シナモン→シナモン：28716_shinamon⟧ (cinnamon)
- ⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧ (ginger)
- ⟦にんにく→大蒜：05190_ninniku⟧ (garlic)
- ⟦{唐辛子|とうがらし}→唐辛子：11871_tougarashi⟧ (chili pepper)
- ⟦クミン→クミン：noentry⟧ (cumin)
- ⟦ターメリック→ターメリック：noentry⟧ (turmeric)
- ⟦{山椒|さんしょう}→山椒：12412_sanshou⟧ (Japanese pepper)
- ⟦わさび→山葵：05121_wasabi⟧ (wasabi)

Japanese cuisine traditionally uses fewer spices than South Asian or Middle Eastern cuisines, relying more on ⟦{薬味|やくみ}→薬味：04964_yakumi⟧ (condiments/garnishes).

Also called ⟦スパイス→スパイス：11054_supaisu⟧ in casual speech.
